Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.

Resolve the Hammerhead ability.

When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Repeat.

Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.

Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain life.

Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2438-2577-2842-2890-4583-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Protean Hulk to die.
2438-2577-2842-2890-4583-4871.description:
Get Protean Hulk killed, triggering its ability.
Get Body Snatcher, Carrion Feeder, and Gravecrawler.
With Body Snatcher's ETB trigger on the stack, sacrifice it to Carrion Feeder, getting back Protean Hulk for its death trigger.
Sacrifice Hulk to Carrion Feeder, triggering its ability.
Get Pitiless Plunderer and Blood Artist.
Sacrifice Gravecrawler to Carrion Feeder, giving it a +1/+1 counter, pinging an opponent with Blood Artist, and creating a treasure token.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard using the created treasure token.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 to ping your opponent to death.
